targets.rawSql:
with latest as (
  select source_database, max(collected_at) as collected_at
  from oracle_session_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database
)
select
  s.inst_id,
  s.sid,
  s.serial_number,
  s.username,
  s.sql_id,
  s.sql_child_number,
  s.event,
  s.wait_class,
  s.state,
  s.seconds_in_wait,
  s.module,
  s.action,
  s.program,
  s.machine,
  s.service_name
from oracle_session_samples s
join latest l on l.source_database = s.source_database and l.collected_at = s.collected_at
where s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and s.sql_id is not null
order by s.seconds_in_wait desc nulls last, s.inst_id, s.sid;

with latest as (
  select source_database, max(collected_at) as collected_at
  from oracle_session_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database
)
select
  coalesce(s.wait_class, 'UNKNOWN') as wait_class,
  coalesce(s.event, 'UNKNOWN') as event,
  count(*) as sessions,
  count(*) filter (where s.sql_id is not null) as sql_sessions,
  max(s.seconds_in_wait) as max_seconds_in_wait,
  max(s.sql_id) as example_sql_id,
  max(s.module) as example_module,
  max(s.machine) as example_machine
from oracle_session_samples s
join latest l on l.source_database = s.source_database and l.collected_at = s.collected_at
where s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and coalesce(s.wait_class, 'Idle') <> 'Idle'
group by coalesce(s.wait_class, 'UNKNOWN'), coalesce(s.event, 'UNKNOWN')
order by sessions desc, max_seconds_in_wait desc nulls last
limit 50;

with latest as (
  select source_database, max(collected_at) as collected_at
  from oracle_session_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database
)
select
  s.inst_id,
  s.sid,
  s.serial_number,
  s.username,
  s.status,
  s.sql_id,
  s.event,
  s.wait_class,
  s.state,
  s.seconds_in_wait,
  s.blocking_instance,
  s.blocking_session,
  s.module,
  s.action,
  s.program,
  s.machine,
  s.logon_time
from oracle_session_samples s
join latest l on l.source_database = s.source_database and l.collected_at = s.collected_at
where s.status = 'ACTIVE'
order by s.seconds_in_wait desc nulls last, s.logon_time asc nulls last
limit 100;

with latest as (
  select source_database, max(collected_at) as collected_at
  from oracle_blocking_session_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database
)
select
  b.inst_id,
  b.sid,
  b.serial_number,
  b.username,
  b.sql_id,
  b.event,
  b.wait_class,
  b.blocking_instance,
  b.blocking_session,
  b.blocking_username,
  b.blocking_sql_id,
  b.blocking_event
from oracle_blocking_session_samples b
join latest l on l.source_database = b.source_database and l.collected_at = b.collected_at
order by b.inst_id, b.sid;

with latest as (
  select source_database, max(collected_at) as collected_at
  from oracle_session_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database
)
select
  coalesce(s.status, 'UNKNOWN') as status,
  coalesce(s.username, '(background)') as username,
  coalesce(s.module, '(unknown)') as module,
  coalesce(s.program, '(unknown)') as program,
  count(*) as sessions,
  count(*) filter (where s.sql_id is not null) as sql_sessions,
  count(distinct s.machine) filter (where s.machine is not null) as machine_count,
  max(s.wait_class) as example_wait_class,
  max(s.event) as example_event
from oracle_session_samples s
join latest l on l.source_database = s.source_database and l.collected_at = s.collected_at
group by coalesce(s.status, 'UNKNOWN'), coalesce(s.username, '(background)'), coalesce(s.module, '(unknown)'), coalesce(s.program, '(unknown)')
order by sessions desc
limit 100;
